key_insight: A scalar low-dimensional embedding can preserve key dynamical signatures of neural network training, including sensitivity to initial conditions and Lyapunov-like behavior.
engineering_relevance: This offers a compact way to analyze, compare, and visualize optimization trajectories in high-dimensional neural network training.
method: Treat training trajectories as temporal networks.
Apply scalar embedding methods to compress the trajectory into a low-dimensional representation.
Compare embedded dynamics to the original parameter-space behavior and evaluate Lyapunov-related measures.
evidence_signal: On MNIST with a multilayer perceptron, the embedding reproduced main dynamical features and accurately reconstructed the maximum Lyapunov exponent.
watch_item: Results are demonstrated on a specific model and dataset, so broader validity across architectures, tasks, and training regimes still needs testing.
paper_title: Scalar Representations of Neural Network Training Dynamics
